why: 1.0.3-beta: pets, Status page report help, alerts

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.3-beta - Persian for WoW Forever.

Fix: the names of players' pets (for example a hunter's pet) are never treated as NPC names any more - they are not translated and no longer fill the list of untranslated things.
New: the Status page explains the list of untranslated things and where to send it (wowfarsi.ir/report or the wowfarsi Discord), with a button that selects the whole line for Ctrl+C.
New in Persian: the alerts Internal mail database error, The item was not found, You are mounted, the zone Trade District and the NPC Klathnar.

A wrong NPC name: target it and type /wowfa target.

Data from ForeverDB.net
